gate: Second dispatch — Pic^0 obstruction parallel to WP-L2
headline: OPEN

correction_b_m1.L1_constraint: L_1(b)=B(b;a,a)=0 is a scalar condition on the normal cone, not the same as F(b)|_{E_t}=0.  Only when an auxiliary horizontal quadratic (or higher) cover Z → P is cut out so that b defines f: Z ⇢ E_t does a Pic^0 class appear.
correction_b_m1.evaluation_on_E_t: At a point z ∈ E_t ⊂ P(E_+), if the normal-order-(m+1) piece b_{m+1}(z, y) is considered as a polynomial in the normal variable y with values in E_+, its vanishing or its projectivization can define maps from subschemes of the normal cone to E_t.
correction_b_m1.transformation_P_to_P_plus_q: If f: Z ⇢ E_t is residual-order-three equivariant, then f(ρ·z) = f(z) + q in E_t.
correction_b_m1.transformation_under_reflections: If f is residual-reflection equivariant, f(σ_i·z) = e_i − f(z).

leading_a_m.divisor_on_E_t: No canonical degree-0 class on E_t from a pure E_--valued jet.  Finite E[2]-charge labels on marked points remain discrete WP-3 data (house rule 7: not sufficient alone).
leading_a_m.evaluation_on_E_t: a_m is E_--valued; it does not directly define a map to E_t.  Restriction of a_m to the zero section of the normal cone is zero for m>0.  The associated map on the exceptional divisor P(N) → L_t = P(E_-) is the projectivized leading jet (dominates L_t by 4A.3).  Pic^0(E_t) is not the target of a_m.

stage_r3_residual.F_plus_on_E_t: F_+ vanishes on E_t by definition of E_t = X ∩ P(E_+).  The class of F_+(b) as a section vanishing on E_t relates to the divisor of contact of the image of b with E_t, but is not automatically a Pic^0 obstruction without a cover and trace.

obstruction_protocol_house_rule_12.live_families: No certified nonzero invariant class in a finite quotient of Pic^0 obstructing the three WP-5 families was found; do not fake one.  Continue with WP-L2 tower / other blockers.
obstruction_protocol_house_rule_12.order12_ansatz: Invariant class −q ∈ E[3] ⊂ Pic^0 exhibited; independence recorded; STOP for the factorized Fable order-twelve gate.

antecedent.Z_P: Primitive horizontal degree-two part of V(q_P) ⊂ P(N_{P/P(W)}).
antecedent.ansatz: Factorized first-gate germ on a fixed involution plane: p_3 = q_P R_P, p_4 = ι_{Γ_{R_P}} η_P, with the audited nonzero three-line Fable boundary.
antecedent.necessary_residue: F(p_4)|_{Z_P} = 0 is necessary for the order-12 landing gate; allowed I^{(5)}/I^{(7)} corrections cannot change it (order-twelve residue ledger).

construction_of_class.split_and_nonreduced: Split horizontal quadratic: each component birational to P, so f constant on each, equivariance ⇒ c = c+q.  Nonreduced: unique reduced component, same.  Vertical factors irrelevant after taking primitive horizontal part.
construction_of_class.step1: If F(p_4)|_{Z_P}=0 and p_4 generically nonzero on Z_P, then f = [p_4] : Z_P ⇢ E_t is a rational map to the plus-plane elliptic (p_4 is E_+-valued of even normal order).
construction_of_class.step2_Pic0: On a horizontal component with function field L, the point f determines ξ = [f − O] ∈ Pic^0(E_t)(L) ≅ E_t(L).
construction_of_class.step3_trace: For irreducible horizontal quadratic L/K, K=C(P), the trace Tr(ξ) = ξ + τξ lies in Pic^0(E_t)(K) ≅ E_t(K).  Constancy of maps P²⇢E forces Tr(ξ) = C constant in E_t(C).
construction_of_class.step4_translation: Residual order-three ρ acts on E_t by P ↦ P+q, q≠0 in E[3], and normalizes the quadratic cover (commutes with τ).  Equivariance of f (residual S3 / stabilizer equivariance of the germ) gives ρ·ξ = t_q(ξ) in Pic^0.
construction_of_class.step5_contradiction: C = Tr(ξ) = Tr(ρ·ξ) = Tr(ξ + q) = Tr(ξ) + 2q = C + 2q.  Since 3q=0, 2q = −q ≠ 0, contradiction.

independence_of_choices: Origin change replaces q by ±q; 2q=−q still nonzero
Scale of p_4 does not change [p_4] in P(E_+)
Representative of p_4 mod I^{(5)} does not change the residue
Choice of horizontal component: both give the same contradiction pattern
finite_quotient_exhibit.invariant_class: The obstruction is the nonzero class 2q = −q in E_t[3] ⊂ Pic^0, forced to vanish by equivariant trace constancy.
finite_quotient_exhibit.protocol: House rule 12: invariant class exhibited in the exact finite quotient E[3] of Pic^0; independence recorded; STOP for this ansatz — do not add higher-order corrections around it.
finite_quotient_exhibit.quotient: E_t[3] ≅ (Z/3)² ⊂ Pic^0(E_t), via the translation class q

order12_quadratic_trace_regression.name: Order-twelve quadratic-trace obstruction (Pic^0 form)
order12_quadratic_trace_regression.proof_type: function-field / Pic^0 trace; no resolution of singularities required
order12_quadratic_trace_regression.scope: Kills the factorized Fable/Koszul full relative-divisor antecedent with audited nonzero three-line boundary at the order-twelve gate.  Does not kill nonfactorized first normal forms, unrelated full-threefold constructions, or the three WP-5 survivor families without additional hypotheses.

pic0_formalism.curve: E_t = X ∩ P(E_+(t)), smooth plane cubic
pic0_formalism.house_rule_7: Full Pic^0 class is the invariant; do not argue from finite E[2]-charge alone.
pic0_formalism.identification: After origin choice O ∈ E_t, Pic^0(E_t) ≅ E_t via L ↦ sum n_i(P_i) with deg 0 ↔ Σ n_i P_i in the group law.
pic0_formalism.origin_convention: Prefer a type-I point as origin so type-I = <q>, type-II = e+<q> for 0≠e∈E[2] (accepted WP-3).

reflections.action_on_E: P ↦ e_i − P for the three nonzero e_i ∈ E[2]
reflections.action_on_Pic0: hyperelliptic involution through e_i: on Pic^0, inversion composed with translation by e_i.
reflections.elements: three residual order-2 elements of S3

translation_by_q.action_on_Pic0: pullback ρ^* : Pic^0 → Pic^0 is translation by q on the identified elliptic, i.e. L ↦ t_q^* L.  On degree-0 divisor classes [P−O] ↦ [P+q − O] only after adjusting origin; more invariantly, ρ acts as translation on E≅Pic^0.

trace_and_norm.constancy: Any K-point of E with K=C(P²) is constant: no nonconstant rational map P² → E (restrict to general lines → P¹→E).
trace_and_norm.norm_Pic0: Nm_{L/K}(ξ) = ξ + τ(ξ) in the abelian group Pic^0 (same as trace for elliptic group law written additively).
trace_and_norm.quadratic_extension: L/K separable quadratic with deck involution τ, K=C(P) or function field of the plane / a rational base.
trace_and_norm.trace_Pic0: For a class ξ ∈ Pic^0(E)(L), set Tr_{L/K}(ξ) = ξ + τ(ξ) ∈ Pic^0(E)(K).  Under E≅Pic^0 this is the elliptic sum of Gal(τ)-conjugates.

cases.missing_for_stronger: A theorem producing, from a based formal lift, a residual-S3-equivariant rational map from a quadratic cover of the plane to E_t with nonzero translation equivariance — not established in this dispatch.
cases.reason: (D)/(S3): The based family has p|_{E_-}=0 and leading jet a_m : exceptional → L_t.  There is no built-in horizontal quadratic cover Z_P from a factorized q_P, and b_{m+1} is constrained by B(b;a,a)=0 rather than by F(b)|_{Z_P}=0.  The order-twelve quadratic-trace hypothesis (equivariant map Z_P ⇢ E_t from an even jet with quadratic horizontal trace) is not part of the based-family definition.  Hence the Pic^0 trace contradiction does not fire on the raw based family.

cases.missing_for_stronger: Identification of a quadratic cover from the e=1 residual or from L_1-kernel geometry, with residual-S3 equivariance of the induced map to E_t.
cases.reason: (D)/(S3): The e=1 swap_both residual fixes the source-line coefficient coupling p|_{E_-}=Δ^m h with h of degree 1.  This is a coefficient coupling on L_t^{src}, orthogonal to the normal-cone Pic^0 data on E_t.  No quadratic horizontal cover of the plus-plane is forced by e=1 alone.  The order-twelve trace obstruction does not apply as stated.

cases.missing_for_stronger: Same as e=1: a bridge from residual line data or L_r kernels to an equivariant quadratic cover map into E_t.
cases.reason: (D)/(S3): Generic e≥7 enlarges the det-twisted residual module but still supplies source-line data, not a quadratic cover of P(E_+).  Same gap as e=1.

cases.missing_for_stronger: Global G-gluing of Pic^0 classes across the 55-plane orbit, or a different global blocker (WP-T1 / WP-H1).
cases.reason: (G): Non-planewise corrections (jets not supported on a single plus-plane normal cone) fall outside the single-involution Pic^0 formalism developed here.  A global G-equivariant gluing theorem would be required; none is claimed.  The order-twelve trace obstruction is a single-plane residual-S3 statement and does not automatically globalize.
Recovered above as the order-twelve quadratic-trace theorem.  The obstruction class is the nonzero 2q∈E[3].  STOP for that ansatz (house rule 12).

trace_tests.protocol: Each claim is labelled by strength: (D) divisor identity on one elliptic; (S3) residual-S3-equivariant identity; (G) global G-equivariant gluing theorem.  These are not interchangeable.

summary.note: A structural kill of the three WP-5 families by Pic^0 trace is not available without additional geometric input producing an equivariant quadratic cover map to E_t.  That is a precisely delimited gap, not a negative or positive theorem.
